verdict.rationale: The IRS has machine-to-machine filing channels that could support batch work: MeF is a system-to-system XML transmission rail, and IRIS offers an Application-to-Application (A2A) intake for information returns. Both sit behind credentialed enrollment: Authorized e-file Provider status (up to 45 days, possible fingerprinting) or a Transmitter Control Code. Consumer-facing flows actively prevent bulk work, e.g. the EIN assistant allows only 1 EIN per responsible party per day, with 15-minute sessions and no save. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch or bulk submission semantics, any bulk operations outside information returns and e-file, open self-serve API access without lengthy provider enrollment, and independent hands-on corroboration.
